level_reasons: regression: asdf/_tests/test_info.py::test_info_module passed before the fix and fails after it

issue.title: closed `AsdfFile` instances hold private reference to tree

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the issue and the fix guards against it, but asdf/_tests/test_info.py::test_info_module passed before the fix and fails after it, which is a regression. Look first at why clearing the tree on close breaks the info module test, for example whether the info code reads the tree after the file is closed.
